reasons: CS4223 prerequisite requires CS3210 or CG3207, neither of which is completed or planned.

CS4222 prerequisite requires EE2012A or EE2012 or EE4204 or CS2105 (completed) AND EE2012A or EE2012 or ST2131 or ST2334 (completed) or MA2116 etc. However, CS4222 is offered only in Sem 2. The student is in Sem 6 (Y3S2). Sem 6 is Sem 2. So CS4222 can be taken in Sem 6. But CS4223 is offered only in Sem 1. The student is in Sem 6. Sem 7 is Sem 1. So CS4223 can be taken in Sem 7. But CS4223 needs CS3210/CG3207. These are not completed. The student has not completed CS3210 or CG3207. Therefore CS4223 cannot be taken.

CS2102 prerequisite requires CS1231/MA1100/MA1100T/CS1231S (completed CS1231S) AND (CS2030S/CS2030/CS2030DE/CS2030HS/YSC2229/CS2040/CS2040C/CS2040S/CS2040DE/CS2040HS). Student has CS2030S and CS2040S. So CS2102 is eligible. CS2101 is eligible. ES2660 is eligible. CS3237 is offered Sem 1. Sem 7 is Sem 1. CS3237 needs (EE2028/EE2024/CG2028/CS2100/CS2100DE/CS2100HS) AND (CS1010/CS1101S/CS1010X/CS1010E/CS1010J/CS1010S/CS1010A/CS1010HS/UTC2851). Student has CS2100 and CS1101S. So CS3237 is eligible. The main blocker is CS4223 due to missing CS3210/CG3207.
